#   FireHOL IP Blocklist › Level 4
#   
#   This blocklist is sourced from FireHOL and aggregates IP addresses
#   which provide maximum protection with minimum false positives. Suitable for
#   basic protection on all internet facing servers, routers and firewalls. 
#   
#   This list is more strict than level1, level2, and level3. It may contain
#   false positives.
#   
#   This blocklist includes the following IP lists:
#   
#   blocklist_net_ua        IPs that have been observed performing attacks,
#                           collected by Ukrainian honeypots.
#   botscout_30d            Bots caught registering on forums and polluting
#                           databases over the last 30 days.
#   cybercrime              IPs used by malware Command and Control servers.
#   iblocklist_hijacked     List of hijacked IP ranges
#   iblocklist_spyware      IPs associated with known spyware.
#   iblocklist_webexploit   IPs associated with web exploits.
#   
#   This is the most aggressive of the firehol levels. It includes lists that
#   may have significant false positive rates. Use with caution and only if
#   you understand the risk. 
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malformed data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
